en: This is a vintage, hand-drawn map-style postcard depicting Scapa Flow, a body of water in the Orkney Islands, Scotland. The map shows surrounding islands (Mainland, Hoy, Flotta, South Ronaldsay, Burray, etc.), and the positions of several ships are marked within the bay. The right side of the postcard includes a list of ship names, all in German, identifying vessels of the German fleet. The map is labeled in German and contains a copyright date of 1919 and the name 'Finke, Wilhelmshaven' at the bottom.
